components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:27px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font:400 13px/1.65 var(--font-body,'DM Sans'),sans-serif}.ds-nav a{color:var(--muted);padding-block:14px;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;transition:color 150ms ease}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--white)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:5px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--gold)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-filters button{min-height:43px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);padding:10px 18px;font:400 13px/1.65 var(--font-body,'DM Sans'),sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:color 150ms ease,background 150ms ease}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--surface-hover);color:var(--white)}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:5px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-filters button:hover{background:var(--surface);color:var(--white)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filters button{transition:none}}

components.name: Package choice
components.description: A labelled radio choice with navy selected surface, ocean stroke and gold keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;position:relative;max-width:300px;font:400 13px/1.65 var(--font-body,'DM Sans'),sans-serif;color:var(--white);background:var(--field);padding:15px 12px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;outline:1px solid transparent}.ds-option input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.ds-option:has(input:checked){background:var(--navy);outline-color:var(--ocean)}.ds-option:has(input:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}.ds-radio{width:18px;height:18px;margin-left:auto;border-radius:50%;outline:1px solid var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.ds-radio svg{visibility:hidden}.ds-option:has(input:checked) .ds-radio{background:var(--action);outline:0}.ds-option:has(input:checked) .ds-radio svg{visibility:visible}

narrative.overview:
The approved DDTC world uses midnight backgrounds, broad destination photographs, white sans-serif headings and quiet champagne details. Saturated blue identifies the main enquiry actions. Generous margins and unboxed experience cards give photography the largest visual role while practical trip information remains readable.

The official client-selected logo is a binding identity asset. Its original serif lettering, travel emblem and gold detail coexist with the interface's sans-serif typography. This document records the implemented website; it establishes no additional print, trademark or corporate artwork rules.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight canvas with tonal navy surfaces.
Destination photography with restrained corners and dark text scrims.
Plus Jakarta Sans headings and DM Sans body text.
Blue enquiry actions, champagne details and visible keyboard focus.
Original DDTC artwork adapted to navigation and full footer contexts.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Use action blue for the existing action and selected-state roles; retain champagne for details and keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Artwork Lettering Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original outlined DDTC letters; never recreate the logo by typing a substitute serif face.

dos: Do preserve the official source artwork and its original serif DDTC contours.
Do use the horizontal, compact and full white/gold variants in their existing navigation and footer contexts.
Do maintain intrinsic logo aspect ratios and the implemented responsive header dimensions.
Do preserve white and ivory text, muted supporting copy, blue actions and champagne focus on the dark canvas.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't replace the supplied DDTC artwork with generic travel symbols or typed lettering.
Don't turn the raster-derived SVG family into an unqualified claim of original vector-master fidelity.
Don't infer new corporate proportions, clear-space requirements or print approval from these web adaptations.
Don't replace the approved navy palette or locally hosted font pairing during routine extensions.
